title: Room
description: A multiplayer game room and its current participants.

code.description: The six-character room code shared by the host.

hostId.description: Identifier of the player hosting the room.

players.description: Players currently associated with the room.

map.description: PUBLIC: authoritative 2D map once the host has started/finished map setup. null before that.

killReadyAt.description: PUBLIC during IN_GAME only. Epoch ms when the impostor's next kill unlocks; 0 = ready now.

tasks.description: Tasks for the current game. Only sent to the assigned player; public room views contain taskProgress instead.

taskProgress.description: Public aggregate of task completion, safe to broadcast.

winner.description: Set once the game is over; indicates which role side won.

reporterId.description: During a meeting: ID of the player who reported the body.

votingDeadline.description: During a meeting: ISO timestamp at which voting ends automatically.

votedCount.description: During a meeting: aggregate number of cast votes (individual votes stay secret until game:meeting_result).

ejectedPlayerIds.description: IDs of players who have been ejected during meetings.

createdAt.description: Timestamp at which the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent room update.
